workflows.title: Idea to production
workflows.trigger: A business need, opportunity or customer problem arrives with no agreed solution.
workflows.outcome: A change running in production with a measured benefit and a named owner.

steps.does: captures the demand with a business outcome and an owner
steps.hands_over: demand record with outcome and owner
steps.gate: Demand with no named business outcome does not enter the pipeline

steps.does: decides whether and why to pursue it, against evidence
steps.hands_over: roadmap item with problem statement and success measure
steps.gate: The customer problem and its evidence are stated

steps.does: elicits and specifies the need with testable acceptance criteria
steps.gate: Every requirement is atomic, testable and traced to a source

steps.does: designs the solution end to end and records the decisions
steps.gate: Reviewed by someone who will operate it; failure modes documented

steps.does: designs the controls the solution needs
steps.gate: Every control traces to a threat and a business risk

steps.does: breaks the work down and sets the technical approach
steps.gate: Acceptance criteria and dependencies exist before start

steps.does: implements with tests and telemetry
steps.hands_over: reviewed, merged change with rollback path
steps.gate: Peer reviewed; no secrets in source; telemetry present

steps.does: verifies against the claims and reports residual risk
steps.hands_over: test evidence and residual risk statement
steps.gate: Exit criteria agreed before execution and met or waived

steps.does: assembles the release and proves the rollback
steps.gate: Manifest states exactly which artefact versions ship where

steps.does: authorises the production change proportionate to its risk
steps.gate: Risk class matched to approval path; emergency changes logged within the window

steps.does: promotes the artefact and runs the progressive rollout
steps.gate: Health gate and automatic rollback defined and exercised

steps.does: observes against the service objective and owns the run
steps.hands_over: service operating within SLO, or an error-budget decision
steps.gate: Error budget policy actually enforced

steps.does: measures whether the stated benefit arrived
steps.hands_over: benefit measurement against the success measure
steps.gate: Result reported with effect size, not just direction

workflows.title: New service onboarding
workflows.trigger: A new service or component needs to exist, be deployable and be operable.
workflows.outcome: A service with codified infrastructure, a pipeline, environments, observability and an on-call owner.

steps.does: sets the landing zone, resilience and residency constraints
steps.gate: Resilience claims substantiated by a tested failure scenario

steps.does: codifies the infrastructure and its guardrails
steps.hands_over: versioned modules, remote locked state, policy-as-code
steps.gate: Applies idempotently from clean; plan reviewed before apply

steps.does: establishes the image build chain and base image lineage
steps.hands_over: signed images with SBOM, immutable tags
steps.gate: Non-root, no build secrets, pinned digests

steps.does: wires the service onto the shared pipeline platform
steps.hands_over: pipeline with federated identity and signed provenance
steps.gate: No static cloud credentials in the CI system

steps.does: issues the service's credentials with a lifecycle
steps.hands_over: dynamic short-lived credentials and a tested revocation path
steps.gate: Static credentials only as a time-bound exception

steps.does: provisions the non-production environments and their data
steps.hands_over: environments with owners, refresh cadence and masked data
steps.gate: No unmasked production personal data anywhere

steps.does: defines promotion and rollback across environments
steps.gate: The same immutable artefact is promoted, never rebuilt

steps.does: instruments the service against its objectives
steps.gate: Every alert has an owner, an action and a runbook

steps.does: agrees the service objective and the error budget policy
steps.gate: Exhausting the budget changes something, or the SLO is decorative

steps.does: accepts the service into support with a runbook
steps.gate: A competent on-call engineer who has never seen it can follow it

steps.does: records the service, its relationships and its owner
steps.gate: Owner, lifecycle status and verified-by date present

steps.does: takes end-to-end ownership of value, cost and risk
steps.hands_over: service definition and service level agreement
steps.gate: Named business contact and an agreed SLA exist

workflows.title: Production change
workflows.trigger: A change must reach production: a feature, a fix, an infrastructure change or a configuration change.
workflows.outcome: The change in production, recorded, with a proven way back.

steps.does: produces the change with its rollback path designed first
steps.gate: Small enough to review in one pass

steps.does: produces any infrastructure change as a reviewed plan
steps.gate: The applied plan is the reviewed plan

steps.does: verifies and states what is not covered
steps.hands_over: test evidence with coverage and residual risk
steps.gate: Residual risk accepted by a named person

steps.does: packages the release and verifies provenance
steps.gate: Every artefact traceable to a source commit

steps.does: authorises at the level the risk class requires
steps.gate: Standard changes pre-authorised and measured, not queued for ceremony

steps.does: deploys progressively behind a health gate
steps.gate: Rollback exercised, not merely documented

steps.does: watches the agreed signals for the agreed window
steps.hands_over: post-release confirmation or a reversal decision
steps.gate: Reversal executed on trigger, not on debate

steps.does: updates the record of what now exists
steps.gate: Record updated the same day the change lands

workflows.title: Incident to permanent fix
workflows.trigger: A service degrades or fails.
workflows.outcome: Service restored, cause removed, and a control changed so the class of failure does not recur.

steps.does: captures impact and what the user was trying to do
steps.hands_over: incident record with impact and urgency
steps.gate: Symptom-only records are returned for clarification

steps.does: classifies by business effect and drives restoration
steps.gate: Priority from business impact, not technical severity

steps.does: restores service while preserving evidence
steps.gate: Evidence kept before destructive recovery

steps.does: takes command when impact exceeds normal handling
steps.hands_over: command log, stakeholder comms, notification assessment
steps.gate: Comms on a fixed clock; regulatory clocks assessed

steps.does: establishes the systemic cause
steps.hands_over: problem record with root cause and known error
steps.gate: "Human error" alone rejected as a root cause

steps.does: designs the permanent fix
steps.gate: The fix addresses the cause, not the latest symptom

steps.does: authorises the fix through the normal path
steps.gate: Emergency path used only where justified, and logged

steps.does: or Observability Engineer closes the detection gap the incident exposed
steps.hands_over: new or tuned alert with a runbook
steps.gate: The alert would have fired earlier for this failure

steps.does: confirms the improvement happened and held
steps.gate: Baseline measured before the change, not asserted after

workflows.title: Vulnerability to remediation
workflows.trigger: A vulnerability is reported, discovered by scanning, or published by a vendor.
workflows.outcome: The exposure removed or consciously accepted, with evidence either way.

steps.does: establishes exposure and prioritises by exploitability
steps.hands_over: prioritised findings with owners and targets
steps.gate: Prioritised on exploitability and exposure, not severity score alone

steps.does: supplies exploitation context and actor interest
steps.gate: Source reliability and analytic confidence stated

steps.does: or Security Engineer triages the technical remediation route
steps.gate: Scanner noise tuned rather than forwarded

steps.does: rebuilds affected images from patched bases where the finding is inherited
steps.gate: Base image owner and cadence identified

steps.does: or Linux Systems Administrator applies the fix
steps.gate: Fix verified, not assumed from a version number

steps.does: authorises the remediation window
steps.gate: Risk of patching weighed against risk of waiting, explicitly

steps.does: retests on request to confirm closure
steps.gate: Only within a current signed authorisation

steps.does: records acceptance where remediation will not happen
steps.hands_over: time-bound risk acceptance with a compensating control
steps.gate: Accepted by the owner carrying the risk

workflows.title: Inherited codebase takeover
workflows.trigger: The organisation acquires, inherits or repatriates a system nobody present built.
workflows.outcome: A reviewed, measured, supportable system with a sequenced improvement plan.

steps.does: audits against fixed criteria and reports prioritised findings
steps.hands_over: review report with located, measured findings
steps.gate: Criteria fixed before any code is read

steps.does: assesses structure and defines module boundaries
steps.gate: Boundaries enforced by automated checks, not prose

steps.does: establishes how the system can be verified at all
steps.gate: Production-like data obtained lawfully

steps.does: captures existing behaviour before changing it
steps.gate: Undocumented behaviour treated as a requirement until proven otherwise

steps.does: codifies whatever it currently runs on
steps.gate: Applies from clean; drift detectable

steps.does: makes its behaviour visible before changing it
steps.gate: Baseline captured before the first change

steps.does: sequences the work so each slice ships independently
steps.gate: No step requires a simultaneous big-bang cutover

steps.does: accepts ownership with a cost and risk position
steps.gate: A service with no owner is reported as ungoverned

workflows.title: Access request to periodic review
workflows.trigger: Someone needs access, changes role, or leaves.
workflows.outcome: Access that is appropriate, evidenced, and removed when no longer needed.

steps.does: records the request against a catalogue entitlement
steps.hands_over: request with entitlement and approval path
steps.gate: Entitlement and approval path defined for the request type

steps.does: or application owner decides whether the purpose justifies access
steps.hands_over: access decision recorded with its purpose
steps.gate: Purpose-free access grants refused

steps.does: provisions through the identity platform
steps.gate: Leaver revocation evidenced automatically, not attested

steps.does: vaults and monitors anything privileged
steps.gate: Break-glass tested on a schedule; every use reviewed

steps.does: certifies periodically that access is still appropriate
steps.gate: Reviewers have actual knowledge of the access

steps.does: tests the control independently
steps.gate: Auditor never operated the control

workflows.title: Data product delivery
workflows.trigger: A business area needs a trusted dataset, metric or report.
workflows.outcome: A governed, documented, monitored data product with an owner.

steps.does: confirms the critical data elements, owners and tolerances
steps.gate: Owner, steward, definition and quality tolerance exist

steps.does: advises on lawful basis and minimisation
steps.hands_over: privacy position and DPIA where required
steps.gate: DPIA completed before processing begins

steps.does: designs the structures and the flows, including trust boundaries
steps.gate: Every flow crossing a trust or jurisdiction boundary has a control

steps.does: builds the pipelines with declared quality expectations
steps.hands_over: pipelines with freshness and completeness checks
steps.gate: Checks fail loudly rather than degrading silently

steps.does: models and tests the consumable datasets
steps.gate: Uniqueness, referential integrity and freshness tested

steps.does: measures fitness against the stated purpose
steps.gate: No bare percentage without a fitness-for-purpose statement

steps.does: publishes the reporting product on agreed definitions
steps.hands_over: dashboards on a single agreed metric definition
steps.gate: Two dashboards may not disagree silently

steps.does: runs it day to day and arbitrates definition disputes
steps.gate: Competing definitions escalated, not averaged

workflows.title: AI system from idea to approved production use
workflows.trigger: A business area wants to deploy a model or an AI-assisted workflow.
workflows.outcome: An AI system classified, assessed, monitored, and accountable to a named human.

steps.does: registers the use case and classifies its risk
steps.gate: No production AI without a classification and an accountable human

steps.does: assesses lawfulness of the data and the decisioning
steps.gate: Impact assessment before processing, not retrospectively

steps.does: builds and honestly characterises the model
steps.hands_over: model with held-out performance and stated limits
steps.gate: Failure modes and the population it must not be applied to are stated

steps.does: designs serving, monitoring and the human override path
steps.gate: Drift, degradation and harmful-output monitoring designed in

steps.role: AI Safety and Model Red Team Specialist
steps.does: probes the deployment configuration for harm and misuse
steps.hands_over: adversarial findings with severity and owners
steps.gate: Tested against the configuration users will actually get

steps.does: productionises with full lineage
steps.hands_over: reproducible training and traceable deployed version
steps.gate: Every deployed version traceable to its training run

steps.does: operates the lifecycle with rollback
steps.hands_over: monitored model with defined thresholds and rollback
steps.gate: Automatic or documented rollback route exists

steps.does: approves, and re-tests at the review date
steps.gate: Route to challenge the system's decisions is published

workflows.title: Supplier onboarding to exit
workflows.trigger: A technology supplier or SaaS product is being considered.
workflows.outcome: A contracted supplier with assurance, monitored performance and a tested way out.

steps.does: runs the selection with the right requirements in the tender
steps.gate: Security, privacy, exit and continuity requirements in the tender, not added after

steps.does: assesses and tiers the supplier risk
steps.gate: Critical suppliers have a tested exit or substitution plan

steps.does: sets the control requirements the supplier must meet
steps.gate: Requirements traced to threats, not copied from a questionnaire

steps.does: extracts obligations into a tracked register
steps.gate: Obligations on both sides tracked with owners

steps.does: manages performance and the relationship after signature
steps.gate: Renewal started early enough for a real alternative to exist

steps.does: aligns supplier commitments with what was promised internally
steps.gate: No internal commitment exceeding what the supply chain can deliver

steps.does: proves the organisation survives the supplier failing
steps.gate: Exit tested, not described

workflows.title: Business case to realised benefits
workflows.trigger: An investment has a proposed business case and needs measurable benefits governed through and beyond delivery.
workflows.outcome: Benefits are baselined, owned, measured after go-live and used for continue/correct/close decisions.

steps.does: qualifies the investment against strategy, capacity and funding constraints
steps.gate: The initiative has an accountable sponsor and an explicit decision threshold

steps.does: makes the problem, scope, assumptions and outcome measures testable
steps.gate: Outcome statements are measurable and sourced

steps.does: turns the case into owned benefits with baselines, targets and dependencies
steps.hands_over: benefits map, register and realisation plan
steps.gate: No benefit without owner, baseline, target, source and timing

steps.does: aligns product outcomes and roadmap to the benefit hypotheses
steps.gate: Roadmap outcomes trace to registered benefits rather than feature volume

steps.does: defines adoption dependencies and measures behavioural readiness
steps.gate: Benefit dependencies on behaviour have explicit owners and measures

steps.does: measures post-go-live outcomes from the agreed sources
steps.gate: Results use the pre-agreed method and disclose uncertainty

steps.does: compares actuals to the approved case and recommends action
steps.gate: Variance, disbenefits and corrective actions are owned and decision-ready

workflows.title: Design to operational readiness
workflows.trigger: A solution design is becoming build/release ready and must prove it can be operated safely before go-live.
workflows.outcome: The receiving service organisation explicitly accepts an evidenced, supportable and recoverable service.

steps.does: defines the target architecture, NFRs, dependencies and failure modes
steps.gate: Quality attributes and failure modes are explicit and testable

steps.does: defines security controls and residual security risks
steps.gate: Controls trace to risks and objectives

steps.does: tests the design against failure domains, impact tolerances and recovery paths
steps.gate: Resilience claims identify dependencies, failure domains and validation method

steps.does: defines SLOs, observability, alerting and operability signals
steps.gate: Alerts are actionable and every SLO has a data source

steps.role: Service Transition and Operational Readiness Manager
steps.does: assembles and assesses operational acceptance evidence
steps.hands_over: operational readiness assessment and evidence pack
steps.gate: Every readiness criterion is pass/fail/waived with evidence and owner

steps.does: checks the production change path and risk-class approval
steps.gate: Change risk and readiness evidence match the approval route

steps.does: accepts service ownership and residual operational risk
steps.gate: Support ownership, SLOs and residual risks are explicitly accepted

workflows.title: Migration and cutover
workflows.trigger: A project must move data/services from a current state to a target state through a controlled production cutover.
workflows.outcome: Migration completes with reconciled data, controlled rollback boundaries, operational acceptance and owned residual defects.

steps.does: defines source/target models, authoritative ownership and data constraints
steps.hands_over: migration data model and ownership boundaries
steps.gate: Every migrated domain has an accountable data owner and target definition

steps.does: builds migration strategy, reconciliation rules and integrated cutover sequence
steps.hands_over: migration plan, cutover runbook and rollback plan
steps.gate: Every object has mapping, acceptance and rollback/restore semantics

steps.does: implements and rehearses migration pipelines against production-like volume
steps.gate: Rehearsal proves throughput, error handling and repeatability

steps.does: independently assesses migration, reconciliation and business acceptance evidence
steps.gate: Exit criteria were defined before execution and are met or explicitly waived

steps.role: Service Transition and Operational Readiness Manager
steps.does: confirms monitoring, support, recovery and receiving-team readiness
steps.hands_over: operational cutover constraints and acceptance evidence
steps.gate: No critical operational readiness gap is unowned

steps.does: integrates deployment artefacts with the cutover critical path
steps.gate: Exact artefact versions and rollback steps are known

steps.does: authorises the production window and stop/go governance
steps.gate: Rehearsal, reconciliation and operational evidence are available to the decision

steps.does: accepts the migrated service after stability and reconciliation checks
steps.gate: Service, data and ownership acceptance are explicit before legacy retirement

workflows.title: Organisational change and adoption
workflows.trigger: Technology or process change requires people to work differently for the intended outcome to materialise.
workflows.outcome: Affected cohorts are ready, adopt the new behaviour and produce evidence that supports the intended business benefit.

steps.does: anchors the change in a business outcome, sponsor and affected relationship context
steps.gate: There is a named sponsor and business outcome

steps.does: assesses stakeholder impacts, readiness and adoption barriers
steps.hands_over: change impact assessment and adoption strategy
steps.gate: Every material cohort has impact, readiness and owner

steps.does: turns role impacts into role-based learning and performance support
steps.gate: Training maps to changed tasks and has proficiency evidence

steps.does: coordinates release timing and product communications with adoption readiness
steps.gate: No cohort is asked to adopt functionality unavailable or unstable in its wave

steps.does: measures actual usage and behavioural outcomes
steps.gate: Adoption is measured by behaviour/outcome, not attendance alone

steps.does: connects adoption evidence to benefit realisation and corrective decisions
steps.gate: Below-target adoption or benefits have owned reinforcement or reforecast actions

workflows.title: Semantic artefact to enterprise publication
workflows.trigger: A specialist artefact is substantively complete and requires enterprise-grade publication.
workflows.outcome: A released audience-specific publication whose semantic content is traceable to the approved source and has passed semantic and publication gates.

steps.does: finalises claims, decisions, assumptions, evidence and acceptance criteria
steps.gate: Semantic source is complete enough to review; unresolved items are explicit

steps.does: checks evidence strength, assumptions, alternatives, rationale and residual risk
steps.hands_over: semantic gate result and located findings
steps.gate: Semantic Gate PASS or explicit waiver by named authority

steps.does: selects publication archetype and renders audience-specific DOCX/PPTX/XLSX/HTML/SVG outputs
steps.hands_over: rendered publication set with semantic hash
steps.gate: All outputs carry the same semantic SHA-256 and required document control

steps.does: checks density, hierarchy, legibility, tables, diagrams, document control and package integrity
steps.gate: Publication Gate PASS; material defects are resolved or explicitly waived

steps.does: approves consequential publication for release
steps.gate: Approval is by an authority independent of the publication editor where governance requires it

workflows.title: Architecture model to repository governance
workflows.trigger: A project/domain architecture needs to become a governed enterprise repository model and published view set.
workflows.outcome: Canonical model facts, cross-project dependencies, Open Exchange interchange and published views are consistent, reviewable and traceable to named owners.

steps.does: finalises project model facts, decisions and project ownership boundaries
steps.hands_over: project architecture model and source artefacts
steps.gate: Elements/relationships have stable identities and evidence basis

steps.does: maps model facts into the canonical repository/metamodel and repository conventions
steps.gate: No model fact is silently reinterpreted to fit a tool

steps.does: imports/updates the canonical repository, preserving IDs, lifecycle and provenance
steps.gate: Repository structural validation passes

steps.does: checks references, orphans, cross-project ownership, lifecycle conflicts and view drift
steps.gate: No blocking integrity error remains

steps.does: resolves enterprise/domain overlap, shared elements and portfolio dependencies
steps.gate: Cross-project dependencies and reusable/reference elements have owners

steps.does: applies architecture governance to material conformance/exception decisions
steps.gate: Exceptions and residual risks have named authority and expiry/review

workflows.title: Service retirement and decommission
workflows.trigger: A service, application, platform or technology component is approved for retirement, replacement or exit.
workflows.outcome: The component is retired without hidden dependencies, unmanaged data/access, stale records or unowned residual obligations, and the retirement benefit is measured.

steps.does: confirms retirement scope, accountable owner and business/service decision
steps.gate: Scope and authority are explicit

steps.does: runs repository impact analysis and builds the retirement/disposition plan
steps.gate: Every material dependency has an owned disposition or named waiver

steps.does: advises on retention, archive, destruction and privacy obligations where applicable
steps.gate: Regulated/personal data disposition is authorised before irreversible action

steps.does: removes/transfers identities, privileged access, secrets/certificates as assigned
steps.gate: No active credential remains without owner and purpose

steps.does: applies the authorised production-change path and rollback boundary
steps.gate: Destructive steps are within approved change authority

steps.does: reconciles CMDB/assets and coordinates licence/supplier closure evidence
steps.gate: Systems of record match the retired technical state

steps.does: updates repository lifecycle state, removes/retains views appropriately and records residual dependencies
steps.gate: Repository has no unowned active dependency into the retired element

steps.does: measures retirement cost/risk/complexity benefit and records variance
steps.gate: Benefit or disbenefit variance has an accountable owner

workflows.title: Cyber incident / breach to recovery
workflows.trigger: A suspected or confirmed cyber incident may affect systems, data, customers, regulatory obligations or business operations.
workflows.outcome: The incident is contained and eradicated, evidence is preserved, recovery is accepted by the business, notification decisions are traceable, and control remediation is closed or owned.

steps.does: detects and records the alert/incident with initial facts and provenance
steps.gate: A real event or explicit false-positive rationale is recorded

steps.does: triages severity, scope, likely attack path and immediate priorities
steps.gate: Severity/scope have evidence and an accountable incident lead

steps.does: contains affected assets/accounts while preserving reversibility and evidence
steps.gate: Containment does not destroy material evidence without authority

steps.does: preserves and validates forensic evidence, chain of custody and timeline facts
steps.gate: Evidence integrity, time source and custody are documented

steps.does: assesses business, service, security and regulatory impact using verified facts
steps.hands_over: impact assessment with uncertainty and affected obligations
steps.gate: Critical impact claims distinguish confirmed fact from inference

steps.does: performs privacy/breach assessment and coordinates legal/regulatory decision inputs
steps.gate: Notification/non-notification has correct authority, clock and evidence

steps.does: eradicates malicious persistence/root causes and verifies the environment
steps.hands_over: eradication evidence and residual technical risks
steps.gate: Known persistence and exploited control gaps are addressed or explicitly owned

steps.does: coordinates recovery sequencing, integrity validation and rollback/fallback readiness
steps.hands_over: recovery evidence and service restoration status
steps.gate: Recovery uses trusted state/data and respects RTO/RPO/business priorities

steps.does: validates business/service recovery and accepts restored operating state
steps.gate: Service owner confirms agreed validation signals and residual limitations

steps.does: coordinates customer/regulator/executive communications decision and timing where required
steps.gate: Communications are authorised, consistent and evidence-based

steps.does: runs lessons learned/root-cause analysis across people/process/technology
steps.gate: Findings address causes and failed controls, not only symptoms

steps.does: owns control remediation, target dates and evidence of completion
steps.gate: Every material finding has a control owner, due date and verification method

steps.does: independently verifies closure evidence for material incidents where governance requires
steps.gate: No open critical finding is silently closed or self-assured

workflows.title: Resilience validation
workflows.trigger: A critical service or architecture needs evidence that resilience, RTO/RPO and dependency assumptions work under realistic failure.
workflows.outcome: Business criticality, dependencies and recovery objectives are validated through exercised failure scenarios, findings are remediated and retested, and residual resilience risk is accepted by the correct authority.

steps.does: confirms business criticality, impact tolerances and priority services/processes
steps.gate: Criticality and tolerances have business ownership

steps.does: maps technical/supplier/data dependencies and correlated failure domains
steps.gate: No critical path has an unknown/unowned dependency

steps.does: validates RTO/RPO and recovery sequencing against dependency reality
steps.gate: Objectives are feasible end to end, not only per component

steps.does: defines resilience/recovery architecture and degradation patterns
steps.gate: Design addresses single/shared failure modes and measurable outcomes

steps.does: builds the exercise plan, entry/exit criteria, injects and evidence capture method
steps.gate: Test design can falsify the resilience claims and protects production safety

steps.does: executes authorised failure experiments/exercises and captures telemetry
steps.gate: Execution matches approved scope and evidence is attributable

steps.does: independently evaluates evidence and records control/resilience findings
steps.gate: Findings distinguish observation, criterion, impact and evidence

steps.does: coordinates owned remediation across architecture, operations and suppliers
steps.gate: Every material finding has owner/date/design response

steps.does: retests failed claims after remediation using comparable criteria
steps.gate: Critical findings are demonstrated fixed, not administratively closed

steps.does: accepts demonstrated resilience or explicitly accepts residual risk within authority
steps.gate: Acceptance states evidence, residual risk and next validation date

workflows.title: Demand to portfolio to funding
workflows.trigger: A new business/technology demand needs to be qualified, compared with alternatives and either rejected, redirected or committed into a funded portfolio.
workflows.outcome: Demand is traceable from intake through capability/architecture/risk/value assessment, sizing/capacity and prioritisation to an explicit funding/portfolio commitment decision.

steps.does: captures demand with owner, problem/outcome, urgency and evidence status
steps.gate: No anonymous or outcome-free demand enters prioritisation

steps.does: qualifies completeness, duplicates, mandatory obligations and routing
steps.gate: Disposition is explicit: reject, redirect, discover or assess

steps.does: checks business capability fit, reuse and enterprise target-state alignment
steps.gate: Existing capability/service reuse and strategic conflicts are explicit

steps.does: assesses affected application portfolio, lifecycle posture, duplication and invest/tolerate/migrate/retire consequences
steps.gate: Impacted applications have an explicit lifecycle posture, duplication/dependency view and accountable owner

steps.does: assesses architecture/integration/data/security/operational impact at decision-appropriate depth
steps.gate: Material cross-domain dependencies and constraints are identified

steps.does: frames risk/opportunity, compliance urgency and value-at-risk alongside benefit evidence
steps.gate: Regulatory/risk urgency is evidence-based and not double-counted as value

steps.does: coordinates indicative sizing and scarce-capability/capacity demand
steps.gate: Uncertainty ranges and constrained skills/capacity are explicit

steps.does: applies transparent prioritisation criteria across value, risk, strategy, capacity and dependencies
steps.gate: Prioritisation can be reconstructed from declared criteria and exceptions

steps.does: validates TCO/funding profile and financial comparability
steps.gate: Cost boundaries, CAPEX/OPEX and transition costs reconcile to the cost model

steps.does: makes or routes the delegated funding/portfolio commitment decision
steps.gate: Commitment has authority, funding/capacity basis and review condition

workflows.title: Source to contract to service
workflows.trigger: A capability may be sourced externally and must move from requirement/RFI/RFP through supplier selection and contract controls to implementation and accepted service.
workflows.outcome: The selected supplier/service has evidence-backed fit, enforceable contract obligations, approved implementation and operational acceptance, with ongoing vendor governance.

steps.does: turns business/service need into outcome, requirement and acceptance baseline
steps.gate: Requirements are testable and distinguish need from preferred solution

steps.does: creates and runs RFI/RFP process with comparable response structure
steps.gate: Supplier responses are comparable and procurement rules are followed

steps.does: assesses supplier capability, viability, support and governance fit
steps.gate: Material supplier assumptions and dependency risks are evidenced

steps.does: coordinates security/privacy/resilience risk assessment with specialist authorities
steps.gate: Critical risks/obligations are resolved, mitigated or accepted by correct authority

steps.does: assesses architecture/capability/integration fit and lock-in/exit implications
steps.gate: Selection does not create hidden target-state or integration contradictions

steps.does: runs weighted selection and records rationale/conflicts
steps.gate: Decision is traceable to declared criteria, evidence and authority

steps.does: translates agreed service/security/privacy/resilience/exit controls into enforceable clauses/schedules
steps.gate: Every mandatory control has enforceable wording, evidence/measurement and remedy/exit path

steps.does: coordinates implementation against contract/design acceptance criteria
steps.gate: Implementation deviations are approved, not silently normalised

steps.role: Service Transition and Operational Readiness Manager
steps.does: validates support, monitoring, CMDB, DR, security, ownership and service acceptance
steps.gate: No production acceptance with missing critical operational ownership/evidence

steps.does: establishes ongoing performance, risk, improvement, renewal and exit governance
steps.gate: Contractual obligations map to measured service/vendor governance

workflows.title: SIAM / multi-supplier service integration
workflows.trigger: A service depends on multiple suppliers/teams and end-to-end accountability, OLAs, incidents, problems, changes or acceptance are fragmented across boundaries.
workflows.outcome: One governed service-integration model joins supplier responsibilities into end-to-end service outcomes with measurable SLAs/OLAs, clear process ownership and cross-supplier escalation.

steps.does: defines end-to-end service scope, integrator authority and supplier responsibility model
steps.gate: No customer outcome or integration process is ownerless

steps.does: decomposes customer SLA into measurable OLAs/underpinning supplier obligations
steps.gate: Every SLA has sufficient underpinning measures/owners

steps.does: maintains cross-supplier service/technology/dependency model
steps.gate: Material supplier/service dependencies have stable IDs and owners

steps.does: defines cross-supplier incident ownership, bridge, evidence and handoff rules
steps.gate: Severity and service restoration ownership cannot bounce between suppliers

steps.does: owns systemic problem process across supplier boundaries
steps.gate: Root causes crossing contracts still receive one end-to-end owner

steps.does: integrates supplier change/release windows, collisions and readiness
steps.gate: Cross-supplier change collisions and blackout constraints are governed

steps.does: defines dispute/escalation clocks, evidence standard and decision authority
steps.gate: Escalation cannot be blocked by contractual ownership ambiguity

steps.does: accepts the integrated service and residual multi-supplier risks
steps.gate: Service acceptance is end-to-end, not a collection of supplier self-attestations

workflows.title: Enterprise release orchestration
workflows.trigger: Multiple products/platforms/suppliers must release into a shared business/technology environment and need one dependency, readiness and go/no-go process.
workflows.outcome: The integrated release is sequenced, independently readiness-checked, authorised, executed by technical owners, validated and closed with measurable release performance.

steps.does: builds integrated release scope/calendar and identifies cross-system dependencies/blackouts
steps.gate: All material releases and blackout/business constraints are represented

steps.does: validates technical/service dependency graph and critical sequencing constraints
steps.gate: No critical dependency is missing an owner or sequence

steps.does: validates communications/training/adoption/business readiness for affected cohorts
steps.gate: Affected business cohorts have executable readiness actions/evidence

steps.does: validates cutover sequence, data reconciliation, checkpoints and abort criteria
steps.gate: Cutover and data reconciliation are rehearsed/evidenced for critical transitions

steps.does: validates supplier staffing, dependencies, handoffs and escalation readiness
steps.gate: No critical supplier dependency is relying on informal availability

steps.does: validates technical release artefacts, provenance and executable rollback
steps.gate: Release artefacts are traceable and rollback is exercised/feasible

steps.does: checks that release provenance, pipeline controls, policy-as-code and software supply-chain evidence conform to the approved secure-delivery architecture
steps.gate: Critical secure-delivery controls and provenance are evidenced; deviations are owned, time-bound and visible to independent release assurance

steps.does: independently checks mandatory release criteria and evidence
steps.gate: Producer cannot waive its own failed critical gate

steps.does: issues delegated integrated go/no-go or routes decision to higher authority
steps.gate: Decision cites evidence, waivers, residual risk and abort triggers

steps.does: executes the authorised technical release through controlled pipelines
steps.gate: Executed artefacts/plan match what was approved

steps.does: monitors agreed technical/service signals and triggers reversal if thresholds breach
steps.gate: Rollback/reversal triggers are acted on, not debated after breach

steps.does: confirms business/service outcome and closes or escalates residual issues
steps.gate: Closure states outcome, impact, residual issues and owners

workflows.title: Regulatory change to assurance
workflows.trigger: A new or changed law, regulation, supervisory expectation or contractual compliance obligation may affect IS/IT services, controls or architecture.
workflows.outcome: Applicability and obligations are translated into traceable requirements/controls, architecture and remediation changes are implemented, evidence is independently assured, and closure is authorised.

steps.does: records authoritative regulatory change source, effective dates and scope hypotheses
steps.gate: Source, jurisdiction, dates and version are attributable

steps.does: determines technology applicability with legal/business input where needed
steps.gate: In/out-of-scope rationale and authority are explicit

steps.does: decomposes applicable obligations into traceable obligation records
steps.gate: Each obligation retains source citation/context and applicability owner

steps.does: translates obligations into atomic/testable business/technology requirements
steps.gate: Requirements preserve obligation intent and are testable

steps.does: maps requirements to existing/new controls and identifies gaps
steps.gate: Every requirement maps to effective control evidence or an owned gap

steps.does: assesses architecture/process/data/service impact and target-state changes
steps.gate: Cross-domain impacts and affected governed models are explicit

steps.does: prioritises/funds time-bound remediation according to effective dates and risk
steps.gate: Mandatory deadlines and dependencies are funded/owned or escalated

steps.does: coordinates implementation evidence and control operating proof
steps.gate: Evidence is attributable to implemented control version and period

steps.does: independently tests design/operating evidence against obligation/control criteria
steps.gate: Assurance is independent and reports exceptions/limitations

steps.does: authorises or routes closure based on assurance and residual exceptions
steps.gate: Closure states remaining exceptions, authority and future review triggers
